questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Energy Principles, Virtual Work, and Deflections
questions.text: State and prove Castigliano's First and Second Theorems and Principle of Virtual Work (Unit Load Method). Calculate vertical deflection and slope at the free end of a cantilever / simply supported beam with varying $EI$ using unit load method: $\Delta = \int \frac{M m}{E I} dx$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Energy Principles, Virtual Work, and Deflections
questions.text: Calculate vertical and horizontal deflections at joint C of a pin-jointed plane truss using Unit Load Method: $\Delta = \sum \frac{N n L}{A E}$.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Influence Line Diagrams (ILD) for Determinate Structures
questions.text: Define Influence Line Diagram (ILD). Draw ILD for support reactions ($R_A, R_B$), Shear Force ($SF_C$), and Bending Moment ($BM_C$) at a section C for a simply supported beam. Calculate maximum bending moment at C due to a train of moving concentrated loads.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Influence Line Diagrams (ILD) for Determinate Structures
questions.text: Draw ILD for forces in top chord, bottom chord, and diagonal members of a Pratt / Warren truss. Calculate maximum tensile and compressive forces due to moving UDL.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Analysis of Determinate Three-Hinged Arches and Suspension Cables
questions.text: Analyze a Three-Hinged Parabolic Arch of span $L$ and central rise $h$ carrying a UDL over left half span. Derive expression for Horizontal Thrust ($H = \frac{w L^2}{8 h}$) and calculate Normal Thrust ($N$) and Radial Shear ($Q$) at a quarter span section.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Analysis of Determinate Three-Hinged Arches and Suspension Cables
questions.text: Analyze a Suspension Cable with supports at same / different levels carrying concentrated loads and UDL. Calculate maximum tension ($T_{max} = \sqrt{H^2 + V_{max}^2}$), minimum tension ($H$), and total cable length.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Indeterminate Structure Basics and Method of Consistent Deformation (Force Method)
questions.text: Explain Static Indeterminacy ($D_s$) and Kinematic Indeterminacy ($D_k$) for beams, rigid frames, and trusses. Analyze a Propped Cantilever beam / Two-Span Continuous beam using Method of Consistent Deformation (Force Method) and draw SFD and BMD.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Slope Deflection Method and Moment Distribution Method
questions.text: Derive Slope Deflection Equations ($M_{ab} = MF_{ab} + \frac{2EI}{L}(2\theta_a + \theta_b - \frac{3\Delta}{L})$). Analyze a continuous beam with support settlement using Slope Deflection Method and draw Shear Force Diagram (SFD) and Bending Moment Diagram (BMD).

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Slope Deflection Method and Moment Distribution Method
questions.text: Explain Moment Distribution Method (Hardy Cross Method): Distribution Factor, Carry-Over Factor, and Stiffness Factor ($4EI/L, 3EI/L$). Analyze a portal frame with/without side sway and draw SFD and BMD.
